prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of change, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: +6.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Pet Selection Showcase: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout showcasing live animated pet previews alongside choice cards. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long decision time. A side-by-side visual showcase helps users evaluate companions faster.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Placement Sandbox Flow: Add an interactive placement testing zone on the final home intro screen so users test desktop pet placement prior to launch. (why: Support received multiple issues where pets did not show on the desktop or users felt lost controlling desktop pet behavior.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Selection Layout: Change the choose_path screen layout to two-column format comparing ready-made adoptable pets directly with custom pet generation. (why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s; presenting both paths side-by-side reduces evaluation time and cognitive friction.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Reframe the choose_path headline and body to highlight quick pet adoption versus personalized pet creation. (why: 76.2% conversion with long mean time indicates users are uncertain about what each onboarding branch offers.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync & Pet Recovery Account Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet memories and prevents desktop pet resets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Incubation Progress & Tip Banner: Enable time estimates, progress bars, and desktop interaction tips on the waiting screen during pet asset generation. (why: The waiting step has a high median time of 201s (mean 2336s); active status feedback prevents users from assuming the app stalled.)
6: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Quality Guidance Banner: Add photo quality instructions and automatic notification badges on the photo upload screen during custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly due to poor input images.)
